player_prompt.intro:
Yu bilong Pleya {player_id} long gem bilong Indian Poker.
- 52-kard dek; yu si bekim kard bilong opoten.
- Ante {ante} chip(s) olsem wan raun, {max_rounds} raun(s) olgeta.
- Valid muv: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (X i wan namba positi <= yu chip kaunt.)
- Haiest hiden kard winim pot long showdown.

invalid_move.ambiguous: Supply exactly ONE bracketed action, e.g. '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', or '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Cannot [check] - you are facing a bet.
invalid_move.amount_min: Bet / Raise i mas winim 1 o moa.
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Nothing to call; you may [check] instead.
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Use [bet X] to open; there is no bet to raise.
invalid_move.insufficient: Ol i no gat planti mani bilong mekim dispela wok.

message.showdown_tie: Showdown tie: tupela {card}. Pot splits  each receives {split}.

outcome.draw: Olgeta taim ol i gat wankain mani kago.
